Definition: Whether the system enables individuals to authenticate themselves or their documents digitally through electronic verification
Comments: CNI chip has 2048-bit RSA digital authentication certificates. CMDCV (Cabo Verde Digital Mobile Key) established by Legislative Decree 5/2020 enables online authentication and digital signature. Autentika platform provides authentication infrastructure.

Definition: Whether authentication is possible through a centralized government portal or digital gateway
Comments: CMDCV and CNI used to authenticate on all government portals via Autentika platform (SSO). Gov.CV unified government portal and Consular Portal use CNI/CMDCV authentication. Citizens access civil records, tax, and other services via authenticated portal.

Definition: Whether individuals can view their data held in the ID database and see how it has been accessed
Comments: Through SNIAC platform, residents can retrieve their civil identification data including IDs, passports, and civil/criminal registry records. Citizens can view and access their own data via the authenticated portal.

Definition: Whether the system enables Know Your Customer (KYC) packet collection for service provision, particularly financial services
Comments: Cape Verde has KYC/AML framework (Law 17/VI/2002). CNI is used for KYC verification in financial services. CNPD enforces data protection in KYC processes. Third-party KYC providers (Smile ID, Accura Scan) verify Cape Verdean CNI for compliance.

Definition: Whether the ID authority and system are subject to general oversight of the courts and judicial review
Value Name: Yes, but not specific to ID
Comments: Cape Verde has a functioning judiciary including an Audit Court (Tribunal de Contas) and justice information system (SIJ). General judicial oversight of government systems exists but no specific ID-dedicated judicial mechanism identified.

Definition: Whether the civil registration and digital ID systems are integrated
Comments: SNIAC and the Civilian ID System fully integrate civil registration (birth, marriage, death, stillbirths) in a stream connecting all civil registries. NOSi digitized notary identification registers from all municipalities since 2001.

Definition: Whether procedural rules for collection, storage, and sharing of ID-related personal data are publicly available and established
Comments: Data Protection Law requires CNPD authorization for personal data interconnection and cross-system sharing. Interoperability framework (PDEX) exists with data governance provisions, but sharing rules are partial — consent-based with CNPD prior authorization required.

Definition: Whether specific regulation or policy addresses digital ID beyond general identification legislation
Comments: Law 43/VIII/2013 establishes SNIAC specifically as the national digital civil identification and authentication system. Decree-Law 19/2014 governs the CNI specifically. Decree 27/2023 regulates electronic identification means and trust services.

Definition: Whether national data protection legislation exists and covers personal data linked to the ID system
Comments: Law 133/V/2001 (original Data Protection Act). Updated by Law 41 (Data Protection Law). Law 42 establishes CNPD as independent enforcement authority. Provisions on data subject rights, controller obligations, cross-border transfers.

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados) is an independent administrative authority with investigative powers, authority to apply sanctions and fines, and oversight over all personal data processing including identity data.

Definition: Whether the digital ID credential serves as legal proof of an individual's identity as codified in law
Comments: CNI is a legally recognized identity document; mandatory for all consular services, legal transactions, voting, and public service access. Required by law for all Cape Verdean nationals from age 4.

Definition: Whether formal legislation (act, law, regulation) governs digital identity including identification acts, digital ID laws, or equivalent legislation
Comments: Multiple legal instruments: Law 43/VIII/2013 (SNIAC), Decree-Law 19/2014 (CNI), Law 75/VIII/2014 (civil registry), Legislative Decree 5/2020 (CMDCV), Decree 27/2023 (electronic transactions/trust services/e-ID recognition).

Definition: Whether the system and the production of credentials can be managed, maintained and developed by in-country technical staff (as opposed to foreign vendors)
Comments: NOSi (Núcleo Operacional para a Sociedade de Informação), a Cape Verdean state public enterprise, built and fully maintains the SNIAC/CNI system. Over 300 applications developed domestically. NOSi also exports digital solutions to other African countries.

Definition: Whether the Ministry of Finance has oversight of the financing and development of the digital ID system
Comments: Ministry of Finance through UGPE (Special Projects Management Unit) has full oversight and manages the Digital Cabo Verde Project financing. NOSi operates under strategic direction of Ministry of Digital Economy/Finance.

Definition: Whether the ongoing management, maintenance and development of the ID system can be funded by sustainable domestic resources
Comments: Mixed financing: World Bank ($40M total), African Development Bank (€45M+) are major external funders. NOSi operates as a revenue-generating public enterprise offering services to public and private sectors, including exports to other African countries. Mix of external and domestic.

Definition: Whether the system collects biometric data and which modalities are collected (fingerprints, facial image, iris scans)
Comments: CNI chip stores facial photo (JPEG2000 format) and two digital fingerprints, plus digital certificates. Biometric voter registration also collects fingerprints, facial images, and signatures.

Definition: Whether identity records are stored in electronic/digital format versus paper-based records
Comments: SNIAC is a fully centralized digital database managed by NOSi. NOSi began digitizing civil identification records from 2001; centralized citizen database operational since 2009. All civil events processed digitally.

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing a national digital identity system, including foundational ID systems that enable authentication across multiple services. Fully deployed means operational nationwide and accepting new registrations.
Comments: Cape Verde's CNI (Cartão Nacional de Identificação) launched 2018 under Decree-Law 19/2014. Mandatory for all citizens from age 4. Deployed nationally including diaspora via Consular Portal. Fully operational nationwide.

Definition: Whether the digital ID system is designed to be interoperable across government agencies and with other systems through APIs or data exchange protocols
Comments: NOSi operates PDEX interoperability framework connecting SNIAC with multiple government information systems. World Bank AF project finances strengthening of this interoperability framework. Gov.CV portal integrates multiple services.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for opening bank accounts and accessing financial services
Comments: CNI accepted for banking KYC/AML compliance (Law 17/VI/2002). Banks use CNI for customer identification. No evidence that CNI is the sole mandatory document for banking; other accepted ID documents also exist.

Definition: Whether credentials are issued free of charge
Comments: CNI costs 550 ECV (~14 EUR). Fee applies for most applicants. Exemptions exist for minors aged 4-7 and citizens over 60 without income. Cost exists for the majority of eligible population.

Definition: Whether the digital ID is recognized or interoperable across borders through regional agreements or travel documents
Value Name: Recognized in some regional contexts (e.g., ECOWAS travel)
Comments: Cape Verde's COVID vaccine certificate was interoperable with the EU Digital COVID Certificate system. Cape Verde is an ECOWAS member; ECOWAS ENBIC framework exists but Cape Verde's CNI does not have confirmed full formal ECOWAS-wide interoperability.

Definition: Age in years at which an individual becomes eligible to register for digital ID
Comments: CNI is mandatory for all citizens from age 4 (optional at birth registration). Children under 4 may be registered at birth optionally. Age 4 falls in the 1-5 year eligibility band.

Definition: Whether registration for digital ID is mandatory, optional, or mandatory for specific groups
Comments: Application is compulsory by law for all citizens of Cape Verdean nationality, resident in the country or diaspora, from age 4. Mandatory for all Cape Verdean nationals.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for accessing public healthcare services
Comments: CNI accepted for healthcare registration and access. Digital health records system (HMIS) being implemented under World Bank project. Healthcare professionals to have access to patient information via integrated system. Not evidence of strict mandatory-only requirement.

Definition: Whether non-nationals including refugees, asylum seekers, and permanent residents are eligible to register
Comments: Foreign residents can obtain a Residence Permit for Foreigners (TRE), integrated with SNIAC and eligible for CMDCV digital authentication. Some non-nationals (legal residents) are eligible for ID credentials; tourists and undocumented migrants are not.

Definition: Percentage of eligible population that has been issued or registered with digital ID credentials
Comments: CNI mandatory from age 4 and fully deployed nationwide including diaspora since 2018. Prior BI card system existed since 1956. Exact current enrollment percentage not published, but national deployment and mandatory status suggest 50-69% or higher coverage.

Definition: Whether ID system undergoes regular security audits, penetration testing, or vulnerability assessments
Comments: NOSi operates as Digital Certification Authority (NOSi-CA) with PKI infrastructure. World Bank project finances technical and legal audits of NOSi legacy systems. National Cybersecurity Strategy implemented. Cybersecurity component under Digital Cabo Verde Project.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for SIM card activation and mobile service registration
Comments: Cape Verde has NO mandatory SIM card registration requirement. Comparitech confirms Cabo Verde is among countries without mandatory SIM-card registration laws (2024/25 data).

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for registering for social assistance programs and accessing social services
Comments: Social security (INPS) uses digital registration and identity verification. CNI is accepted for accessing social protection benefits. No evidence that CNI is strictly mandatory as the only document; other proofs may be accepted.
